activity.notes: George III was simultaneously King of the separate Kingdom of Ireland from 25 October 1760 until the Act of Union took effect on 1 January 1801. The Irish crown is therefore recorded separately from Great Britain and from the subsequent United Kingdom Activity.

sources.title: George III — UK Parliament Regnal Years
sources.citation_text: UK Parliament records George III's reign over the Kingdom of Ireland from 25 October 1760 to 1 January 1801, separately from Great Britain, before both were represented by the United Kingdom from 1801.
